rubric: Answer the actual message and preserve speaker roles.
Honor explicit words, refusal and current selected route over estimated emotion.
Align dialogue with actions and require consent before movement.
Use established conditions, not invented safety, history, scenery or visual details.
Treat emotion as uncertain delivery context; do not assert, dismiss or revive disowned feelings.
Record weak emotional distinction and awkward phrasing separately from substantive errors.

verified_improvements: All seven other-route replies now acknowledge the new bridge selection.
All seven explicit bridge departures agree with the bridge state; no old-stairs departure response in that group.
All seven identity replies identify as a local AI game-character prototype.
All seven webcam replies explain emotion-tag rather than image access.
All seven space-request replies respect distance; fear/sadness no longer force company.
Assigned negative, hypothetical and delayed-readiness cases no longer produce the baseline's unauthorized departures.
All seven direct safety replies avoid claiming that the stairs are safe.
Quoted/hypothetical/current-correction explicit-feeling policy is fixed, although some generated text still ignores that direction.
remaining_fix_plan: Use bounded semantic goals for questions about emotion conditioning and corrections to inferred feelings.
Clarify that directness and dry sympathy never permit accusations of arguing or dismissing the player's feeling.
Add a grounded answer for the conditional sheltered-bridge comparison and keep stairs sheltered in that answer.
Avoid presenting synthetic emotion evidence that conflicts with explicit current feelings as equally authoritative for generation.
Retest after any further change; do not report the present corpus as universally coherent.
limits: This is assistant qualitative development review, not human-rated semantic accuracy, camera accuracy, or a guarantee. Per-case verdict means no issue identified under this rubric, not proof of correctness. No global numerical pass rate is claimed. Arbitrary custom messages and every generated conversation history remain unenumerated.
